sample.title: REAL: SAM proposes, Spark chooses (recorded set-of-mark chain, solved task)
sample.description: Recorded set-of-mark chain on one SOLVED task (000006 of seed 41, dropdown, chain hit, direct miss): recorded voice transcript -> SAM 3.1 candidate boxes with numbered marks -> Muse Spark choice of one mark -> deterministic IoU check vs ground truth. Replay only; no live model calls. Synthetic screenshots; transcripts recorded from a prior chain run; small n. Fresh-seed confirmation: seed 41 (variant fixed in advance) 16 of 20 IoU>=0.5 vs 3 of 20 direct; seed 23: 12 of 20 vs 5 of 20, exploratory; checkbox elements remain a failure case.
chain: Run footer (2 seeds, n=20 per seed, exploratory)
